title: Governor of Odisha meets the Prime Minister
body_text:
Governor of Odisha, Shri Braj Mohan Ram met the Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi today. The Prime Minister posted on X: Governor of Odisha, Shri Braj Mohan Ram met Prime Minister @narendramodi @GovernorOdisha Governor of Odisha, Shri Braj Mohan Ram met Prime Minister @narendramodi.

@GovernorOdisha https://t.co/mReb00LAfo — PMO India (@PMOIndia) November 2, 2026 **** MJPS/SS/VJ
